name: Mail flow rules
description: Lists mail flow (transport) rules in priority order with state, mode, description and whether each redirects or copies mail, routes through a connector or bypasses spam filtering.

parameters.name: OnlyEnabled
parameters.label: Only enabled rules
parameters.help: Leave out rules Exchange reports as disabled. A rule whose state is unknown is kept.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.label: Maximum rules
parameters.help: Stops after this many rules and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read organisation configuration.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Only the redirect, copy, connector and spam filtering actions are summarised; the Description column holds Exchange's full wording of each rule.
BypassesSpamFiltering reflects only the bypass spam filtering action (spam confidence level -1). A rule that skips filtering another way, such as by setting a message header, is not detected here.
Rules are read up to the limit; a fuller result is marked partial.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
